page.layout: One title page. Hebrew title at the top, then centred roman and italic title lines. Below them an engraved tree with a banner, flanked by two oval seals. At the foot, the imprint in centred lines.

main_text.l: Additis, præter accuratas figuras, commentariis, quibus tota
templi Hierosolymitani structura cum partibus suis, altari
cæterisque eò pertinentibus, ē Talmudistarum aliorumque
Judæorum scriptis distinctè explicatur, variaque Scripturæ
SS. Theol. Doct. & Ling. Heb. ac Chald. in Academia

page.notes: Engraving between the title and the imprint: a tree with a banner reading "NON SOLUM" and a figure beside it. The two oval seals on either side (one reading "BIBLIOTHECA FLORENTINAE" with a fleur-de-lis, the other with a shield and "PAVL... FLOR... CARD... S. PAVLI" lettering) are library stamps and are not transcribed. The year in the imprint is partly obscured; "1655" is my best reading. The Hebrew second line ends with a sign I could not identify with certainty. Pencil marks ("2.6 498", "708") are shelf marks and are not transcribed.
